Hi Marissa,

We’re moving GreenWave’s co-sell listing for Redwood through the AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace intake and the marketplace security review asked us to assemble a single bundle of compliance artifacts. Can you share the following by EOD Thursday (2026-09-16)?

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (cover page + letter) or a certified attest URL
- Executive summary or letter from the latest third-party penetration test (redaction OK)
- A signed standard DPA (we can provide a redline if needed)
- Short notes on key controls: KMS usage for customer data encryption, data residency options, and retention policies

Also please confirm whether your pen test includes external network and authenticated app tests and whether any critical findings were open in the last 12 months. Marketplace teams typically require an owner for follow-up questions — cc’ing marketplace-security for their intake queue.

Thanks,
